formal_rule: any failed G1-G12 gate stops formal; no threshold, seed, policy, or population amendment is allowed

gates.statement: all runs and registered metrics are finite; zero message/environment budget violations
the exact registered task/mixing/correlation/delay/budget/policy/seed population is present
every public joint regeneration certificate satisfies lambda_upper <= 1-gamma
common/private complete-trajectory coupling and source-bank hashes are recorded; no observation-noise dependence shortcut
information-only API contains no true rho, source mask, held-out error, MC return, teacher, or outcome input
all paired policies receive identical message and environment budgets and remain communication matched
learning-aware median selected q is strictly smaller at rho=0.9 than rho=0
learning-aware median b under nonzero delay is not smaller than under zero delay
in high-correlation nonzero-delay cells, geometric terminal prediction risk learning-aware/information-only <= 0.98
the same primary ratio is <=1.05 separately on CartPole-v1 and Acrobot-v1
learning-aware is <=1.10 versus the pilot best-fixed-q envelope in geometric mean and CVaR90
controller wall fraction <=0.10 and every run reports server ticks, agent transitions, Bellman error, prediction error, AUC, resources, and q/b traces
